tasks.notes:
# Task #55 — src/commands/run.ts: collapse completion-flag probe and temp-file cleanup

## Outcome

Both targeted legacy fallbacks removed. `bun test test/commands/run.test.ts` → **114 pass, 0 fail**.
`bun test` → **859 pass, 0 fail, 31 files** — identical to the #54 baseline.
Health check (`bun build --target=bun src/index.ts --outfile /tmp/cairn-healthcheck`) → OK.
Did **not** modify `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck`; did **not** run `./install.sh`.

## Source changes (src/commands/run.ts)

1. **Import (line 17)** — `import { tempFilePath, allTempFilePaths } from '../utils'`
   → `import { tempFilePath } from '../utils'`.
2. **`TEMP_FILE_SUFFIXES` doc comment (~line 358)** — dropped the second line
   ("Cleanup covers BOTH prefixes — a legacy-named leftover is just as stale."), which
   was no longer true after change 4. It carried no marker (it never says "ralph"), so
   `test/legacy-markers.test.ts` was unaffected either way.
3. **Completion-flag probe (~line 439)** —
   `allTempFilePaths(dataDir, 'complete').some((p) => deps.existsSync(p))`
   → `deps.existsSync(tempFilePath(dataDir, 'complete'))`, and deleted the two-line
   legacy comment plus its `remove once all projects migrated` marker.
4. **Cleanup loop (~line 693)** — the inner `for (const filePath of allTempFilePaths(...))`
   collapsed to a single `const filePath = tempFilePath(dataDir, suffix)`.

Net: markers in this file went 3 → 2.

## Deliberately untouched (per task's CRITICAL section — verified still in place)

- `NOTES_TEMPFILE_RE` (now ~line 362) and its doc comment carrying the marker at line 363.
- The notes-sweep comment block and its marker, now at line 708.
- `buildSystemPrompt`'s `notesFile` (~line 48) — still hands agents `.ralph_task_<id>_notes.md`.

`grep -n "remove once all projects migrated" src/commands/run.ts` → exactly lines **363**
and **708**. Task 63 rehomes those; they must survive until then.

`allTempFilePaths` is still exported from `src/utils.ts` and still consumed by
`src/task-archiver.ts:90` (stale `prev_notes` sweep) and internally by
`findTempFilePath` (`src/utils.ts:127`). **Do not delete the helper yet** — a separate
task owns `task-archiver.ts`.

## Test changes (test/commands/run.test.ts) — TDD, red observed first

Both existing legacy-behavior tests were **inverted** rather than deleted, so the new
single-prefix behavior stays pinned:

1. `'breaks loop when only the legacy .ralph_complete flag exists'`
   → `'does not break loop when only a legacy .ralph_complete flag exists'`.
   Now asserts `expect(deps.spawnClaude).toHaveBeenCalled()`.
   **Gotcha:** the default `makeRunDeps` has `selectNextTask: mock(() => null)`, so the
   loop exits with zero spawns regardless of the flag — the first red run failed for the
   *wrong* reason. Fixed by passing `selectNextTask: mock(() => task)` and
   `makeRunOpts({ maxIterations: 1 })` (otherwise a never-null task selector runs the
   full 30 iterations). Same pattern as `'respects maxIterations'` (~line 924).
2. `'cleans up legacy-prefixed temp files on exit'`
   → `'does not sweep legacy-prefixed temp files on exit'`. Same `existsSync` fixture
   (only `.ralph_*` present), assertions flipped `true` → `false`.

`'breaks loop when .cairn_complete flag exists'` and `'cleans up temp files on exit'`
(current-prefix cases) were left as-is and still pass.
The `.ralph_task_<id>_notes.md` sweep test (~line 2020) was untouched and still passes —
that path goes through `readdirSync` + `NOTES_TEMPFILE_RE`, not `allTempFilePaths`.

## Notes for future tasks

- `makeRunOpts()`'s default `dataDir` is still `/projects/myapp/.ralph` (test/commands/run.test.ts:727),
  and line 173 asserts the prompt contains `/projects/myapp/.ralph/.cairn_complete` —
  a fixture-name artifact, harmless, out of scope here (cosmetic-rename territory).
- No discovered tasks this iteration.

tasks.title: Decide the fate of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain — no production callers remain
tasks.description: Task #51 deleted warnIfLegacyApiKey and its two call sites (src/commands/narrate.ts, src/commands/run.ts), which were the only consumers of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain(). The function is still exported from src/config.ts and covered by test/config.test.ts, but nothing in src/ calls it — the resolution is now purely documentary, mirroring the same chain in lib/cairn_narrate_server.py (see task #59). Either (a) delete the helper, its AnthropicApiKeyResolution type, and its tests, leaving the Python server as the single implementation, or (b) keep it and give it a real caller — e.g. have runNarrate/runRun pass the resolved key into the narration server env instead of relying on the child process re-reading the environment. Do NOT normalize onto plain ANTHROPIC_API_KEY under either option: the loop deliberately blanks that name to force Max-plan usage. Sequence this after #59 so both sides of the mirror are decided together.
